title: Annual report and accounts 2025
summary: Income, spending, callouts and the year in pictures.
body: Income $412,600; spending $371,900. 41 callouts, 53 people helped. The full report is presented at the AGM each January.

title: Procedure: mud rescue on the saltmarsh
summary: How we approach, stabilize and extract a casualty stuck in mud.
body: 1. Approach from the creek side on mud boards, never across open mud. 2. Mud lance and water pump to free the legs. 3. Casualty onto the mud sled, then to the boat. 4. Every casualty checked for cold.

title: Kit check rota: November
summary: Who checks drysuits, lifejackets and the tractor each week.
body: Week 1: Red Watch. Week 2: Amber Watch. Week 3: Blue Watch. Week 4: Green Watch. Lifejacket cylinders were re-weighed on Oct 28; two were replaced.

title: Winter operations bulletin
summary: Night launches, ice kit and the new pager test time.
body: The weekly pager test moves to Sunday 10:00 from November 15. Ice kit is back in Rescue 3. Night launches need a minimum crew of three.

title: Pager test log: October
summary: Who answered the weekly pager tests last month.
body: Response to tests: 94%. Two pagers replaced. Please acknowledge every test, even when you are off watch.

title: Minutes: board meeting, October 21
summary: Boat appeal, reserves policy and the new volunteer coordinator.
body: 1. Boat appeal at 74% of target; board approves the builder's deposit of $40,000. 2. Reserves policy: six months of running costs, to be reviewed in March. 3. Volunteer coordinator post agreed at 20 hours a week.

title: Board paper: new boat procurement
summary: Builder, timetable, stage payments and the risks.
body: Builder selected after three quotes. Stage payments: deposit $40,000; hull complete $120,000; delivery $125,000. Delivery in April 2027 if the appeal reaches $250,000 by January.

title: Risk register: quarter four
summary: The top risks to the charity and what we are doing about them.
body: High: the Ellwood boat's age before replacement. Medium: crew numbers on Green Watch; fundraising income falling with the economy. Low: station building.

title: Management accounts to September
summary: Income and spending against the budget, nine months in.
body: Income $318,200 against a budget of $301,000. Spending $262,400 against $270,000. Boat appeal funds are held in a restricted account.

title: Safeguarding policy review
summary: Changes to the safeguarding policy for under-18 crew and school visits.
body: Proposed: two adults present at every youth training session; background checks renewed every three years. For approval on November 25.
